question: Nandadevi Biosphere Reserve is located in:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttarakhand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Nanda Devi Biosphere Reserve** is located in the state of **Uttarakhand**, India.
 
• It was established as a biosphere reserve in **1988** and later included in the UNESCO World Network of Biosphere Reserves in **2004**.
 
• The reserve encompasses an area of **5,148.57 square kilometers**, including the Nanda Devi and Valley of Flowers National Parks.
 
• Nanda Devi Biosphere Reserve is known for its **high biodiversity** and is home to several endangered species like the **snow leopard** and **Himalayan musk deer**.
 
• The reserve is located in the **Western Himalayas** and includes some of the highest peaks in India, such as **Nanda Devi (7,816 meters)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **UNESCO World Heritage Sites**

 
 
• Nanda Devi and Valley of Flowers National Parks were jointly designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in **2005**.
 
• The region is recognized for its exceptional natural beauty and rich floral diversity.
 
 
 
• **Flora and Fauna**
 
 
• The biosphere reserve hosts a variety of plant species, including **rhododendrons** and **junipers**.
 
• It is a habitat for numerous animal species, such as the **Asiatic black bear**, **blue sheep**, and more.
 
 
 
• **Conservation Efforts**
 
 
• The Indian government, along with international organizations, has undertaken several initiatives to preserve the biodiversity and ecological integrity of the reserve.
 
• Local communities are involved in conservation efforts to ensure sustainable development in the region.
 
 
 
• **Tourism**
 
 
• The Nanda Devi Biosphere Reserve attracts numerous tourists due to its scenic beauty and trekking opportunities.
 
• Strict regulations are in place to minimize the impact of tourism on the delicate ecosystem.
